Happy 18th Birthday,Langga ko

Happy Birthday, Langga

Enjoy your special day, Langga. This day is all about you.

Here’s the thing: thank you so much for always being there for me and for all the effort you make just so we can see each other. I’m truly grateful that you came into my life. I honestly can’t imagine my life without you, langga.

I’m sorry for all the times I’ve hurt you, for the days when we argue, and for the moments when I make things difficult. I hope you never give up on us, especially on the days when I’m hard to love. I know I’m not perfect, but I promise that I’ll always try to become a better person for you and for us.

I wish you nothing but the best in life. I hope we both become successful and achieve all the dreams we have together. I hope that someday, it will really be us—together for good. And I hope you’ll continue to love me even during the times when things aren’t always happy or easy.

Thank you for loving me, understanding me, and staying by my side.

I love you more than anything, Langga.

Happy 18th Birthday, my love! I hope you enjoy every moment of your special day. You deserve all the happiness in the world.

Happy 9th Monthsary

Happy 9th Monthsary

Happy 9th Monthsary, langga

Time flies so fast, doesn’t it? It feels like it was just yesterday when I was still courting you. We were both so shy around each other back then, and now look at us—we’re already so comfortable with each other. hehe

I’m just really happy because even though we go through phases where things get difficult between us, we always find a way to get through them and survive together. Hehe.

I’m sorry if I can be too annoying sometimes, langga. I’m also sorry for the times when the things I say accidentally offend or hurt you. I really am sorry. I never mean to hurt you, and I hope you know that.

I hope that someday, we’ll reach the point where we’re both successful and finally become husband and wife. I really hope that we’ll continue choosing each other through everything that life brings our way.

I love you so much, langga ko

And I hope you’ll appreciate this birthday and monthsary gift I made for you. I actually coded this just for you. Hehe.

I love you so much, langga ko.
